title.zh: 渡轮码头乘船报到助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Check passenger bookings, issue check-in records and escalate discrepancies under supplied procedures.
requirements.zh: 按所提供流程核对乘客预订、发放乘船报到凭据并上报差异。

requirements.en: Give current gate information and relay approved service-change messages and assistance requests.
requirements.zh: 提供当前登船口信息，并转达获批服务变更消息及协助请求。

requirements.en: Maintain traceable group check-in records and clear unresolved-booking handovers.
requirements.zh: 维护可追溯团体乘船报到记录，并清晰交接未解决预订事项。
